reason: The TASK-562 survey found that Scripts/Integration/doctor defaults to a misspelt socket directory ('Application Support/DiskSteward') while the app, the helper and the session script use 'Application Support/Disk Steward'; doctor therefore always reports the app unavailable unless --socket is passed. Correcting the session socket contract (AC-TASK-562-01: 'Session entry point uses the canonical socket') requires this existing file.
boundary_review: One existing file on the already-impacted ASSET-CLIENTS (IMPACT-TASK-562-CLIENTS); the change is a one-line default-path correction plus its regression in Tests/IntegrationInstallTests (already in scope). Acceptance, non-goals, dependencies, commands and authority of TASK-562 are unchanged.
